title: Summarize known supplier purchase exposure amounts by currency and link state
description: A purchasing user sees cautious current-page order and settlement evidence by supplier and original currency, optionally split by link state. Development only. Reuse ERP-148 authorized bounded preview over ERP-031; keep all grouping to the current page, recheck current-user purchase-order menu and use existing HTTP operation audit. Preserve unknown settlement/receipt evidence, distinct currencies and ambiguous/unavailable links; never infer an accounts-payable balance or payment authority. Invalid modes and missing permission fail closed. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Preview accepts only none/supplierCurrency/supplierCurrencyLink monetary modes and validates them before source reads with ERP-148 permission and paging.

Summary separates suppliers and currencies; ordered amounts are page-only; settled/outstanding/submitted totals use linked known rows only, while ambiguous/unavailable order amounts and unknown values remain separate or null.
Unit tests cover multi-currency suppliers, linked and ambiguous/unavailable orders, unknown amounts, empty/page boundaries, denied users and no writes; document evidence limits.
